lines.text: A warrant has been issued for your arrest. Do not hang up.
Madam, you are under digital arrest.
Same script. Every country.
Authority… fear… isolation… and an unusual payment.
Last year, Americans over sixty reported {$7.7 billion|seven point seven billion dollars} in losses to the FBI.
India has blocked over {83,000|eighty-three thousand} WhatsApp accounts used for digital arrest.
Caller ID and awareness only work before the call.
Nothing helps during it.
So we built {Ruko|Rooko}. In Hindi, it means: wait.
A calm second voice in the room, during the call.
This is Inspector Rajesh Sharma, from Mumbai Cyber Crime.
{Ruko|Rooko} hears it. On the device, the rules call it safe. Seconds later, Claude says: be careful.
You are under digital arrest. Do not disconnect, and do not tell anyone.
Every flag quotes the caller's own words. The meter hits danger, and never drops.
Transfer your savings to an RBI verification account.
Before any money moves, {Ruko|Rooko} tells her what to say.
I will not transfer any money, and I am hanging up now to call my family and the police directly.
Hang up. This is a scam. Help, and family, are one tap away.
You can settle the balance right now with Apple gift cards.
Same script in Ohio. Same catch.
I am not paying anything over the phone, and I am hanging up now.
Please remember, the bank will never ask for your PIN or OTP.
And a real call? No red flags, no warning. Just a gentle be careful.
A strange text? Paste it in. Same verdict, in seconds.
On your device, rules for {13|thirteen} scam tactics, in English, Hindi and Hinglish, react instantly.
Claude reads the intent, and quotes the caller.
{Ruko|Rooko} shows the higher score, so a scammer can't talk it back to green.
On {32|thirty-two} cases we wrote:
Rules alone caught {16|sixteen} of {18|eighteen} scams. With Claude, all {18|eighteen}.
{2|Two} of {14|fourteen} real ones still got a caution. We show that too.
No accounts. No audio leaves the device. Big type, screen-reader announcements, and Hindi.
Next: Android call screening, more languages, and bank and {NGO|N G O} partners.
{Ruko|Rooko}. Wait, before you pay.
